medium.description:
Type of storage medium to back this directory. The default is "", which means use the node's default medium.
Must be an empty string (default) or "Memory".

sizeLimit.description: Total amount of local storage required for this EmptyDir volume.

title: [EmptyDir](https://kubernetes.io/docs/reference/kubernetes-api/config-and-storage-resources/volume/#Local-Temporary-Directory) is a local, temporary directory that shares a pod's lifetime.
